scenes.title: Possible, yet missing
scenes.viewerPurpose: Show the preventive-service funding mismatch concretely; Name artificial impossibility as an institutional gap
scenes.composition: Place prevention costs in one budget and future savings in several other budgets with no paying owner. Hold the useful project between those budgets, showing the missing sponsor rather than a broken invention.
